measurement: One worker per equation runs the Zoo record builder: local dimension, embedded resolution with both zetas and the pole check, intrinsic resolution, an exhaustive pole-check replay when the quick check is unresolved, then the Milnor and Tjurina numbers. Each resolution is a quick search with a 10-second budget, and the 10-second wall clock covers the whole record. Six equations ran at once on an Intel Core i7-1355U (10 cores, 12 threads). A certified case has complete geometry in both modes, both zetas and a verified pole check.

families.I02: Invertible polynomials: sums of chain, loop and Fermat blocks
families.I03: Curve and surface germs, stabilised by squares or suspended by a power
families.I04: Joins of curve and surface germs in separate variables
families.I05: Cusps: a sum of powers plus the product of all variables
families.I06: Convenient Newton polyhedra with mixed monomials under the diagonal
families.I07: Cones over hypersurfaces of degree 3 to 5
families.I08: Superisolated germs over hypersurfaces with isolated singular points
families.I09: Hidden coordinates: a known germ after a linear or triangular change of coordinates
families.N01: A monomial in k variables plus powers of the others
families.N02: Sums of monomials in disjoint groups of variables
families.N04: Partial cusps: a product of distinct variables plus powers of some variables
families.N05: Transverse compositions h^j + powers along a singular hypersurface of a coordinate subspace
families.N06: Cones over singular curves and surfaces with a prescribed double or triple point
families.N08: Products of germs in separate variables
families.N09: Line singularities, alone or joined with a power
families.N11: Newton polyhedra with a B1 facet
families.N13: Random Newton polyhedra, singular along a coordinate subspace
